**Interested in a career that matters?**
 Interested in a career that matters?

As an Account Manager within Animal Health \& Nutrition, you will play a key role in accelerating the adoption of probiotics, enzymes, and other biosolutions that create measurable value for customers and contribute to a more sustainable future.
   

  

 You will join a commercially driven team focused on developing long\-term partnerships with feed manufacturers, integrators, nutritionists, veterinarians, and channel partners across South Asia. Working closely with technical and commercial colleagues, you will help customers address business challenges while delivering sustainable growth for Novonesis. * Excellent business acumen and strategic thinking.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex customer organizations.

* Customer Focus
* Strategic Thinking
* Commercial Ownership
* Influencing \& Negotiation
* Relationship Building
* Execution Excellence

* Experience within enzyme, probiotic, animal health, animal nutrition, feed additive, or feed manufacturing organizations.

* Proficiency in Bengali, particularly for customer engagement and business development activities in Eastern India and Bangladesh.
* Advanced presentation, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
* Experience presenting technical and commercial solutions to large customer groups and senior leadership audiences.


 This section follows the guide's recommendation to clearly separate preferred qualifications from mandatory requirements.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

 At Novonesis, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of animal nutrition and sustainable food production. We offer:

* Exposure to cutting\-edge biosolutions and industry\-leading expertise.

* Continuous learning, development, and career growth opportunities.

* Regular engagement with customers, distributors, consultants, and industry stakeholders.
* Flexible and field\-based working environment with significant time spent at customer locations and industry events.


**Our purpose guides the way**
 In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. title: Senior Manager - Enterprise Sales
description:
**Title: Senior Manager \- Enterprise Sales** 




  





**About Us:** 




 Setu is reimagining the digital financial future of India. Our products power onboarding, payments, lending, deposits, and financial data flows for dozens of businesses, making complex journeys simple, secure \& scalable.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 At Setu, we believe in collaboration\- both in action and spirit. Setu has been partnering with diverse FIs to sell\-to, sell\-with and co\-create innovative products. In the last 6 months, we have specifically signed a few marquee partners to co\-sell. Now we are looking to build the partnership team as a separate business function to start contributing to revenue. On the other side, we work with many critical data partners like NSDL, e\-Mudra among others to co\-create some of our key products.
 



 This role is special since it will give you the opportunity to look at the entire market and not be limited by any particular segment or use case. You along with your team can bring immense value to organization by thinking out of the box and bringing business from the initially non\-comprehended avenues.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 




 In this role, you’ll play a key role in growing our data products business by identifying opportunities, building trusted relationships with enterprise clients, and driving deals end\-to\-end. You’ll act as the bridge between customer needs and Setu’s product capabilities — helping large enterprises unlock the power of data through our APIs and platforms. You will:
 



  




* **Drive enterprise acquisition and growth** 
 — identify, qualify, and close opportunities with banks, fintechs, NBFCs, and large enterprises.
* **Lead conversations that matter** 
 — understand customer use cases deeply, position Setu’s data products as solutions, and craft proposals that deliver measurable value.
* **Own the sales cycle** 
 — from pipeline generation to closure, ensuring smooth coordination across product, legal, and implementation teams.
* **Be the customer champion** 
 — gather insights from the field and work closely with product and data teams to shape future capabilities and use cases.
* **Track and deliver outcomes** 
 — manage revenue targets, maintain healthy pipeline hygiene, and report progress with clarity and ownership.
* **Represent Setu with credibility** 
 — embody our consultative, problem\-solving approach in every client interaction.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 




 To excel in this role, you will need—
 


* **Empathy:** 
 We operate with a profoundly consultative approach. Empathy for the partner is a crucial requirement for this role. Asking relevant questions to understand their needs and motivations is critical. Making them feel heard can make all the difference between a transactional relationship and a true long\-term partnership.
* Exceptional
 **storytelling skills** 
 in both verbal and written form. Stories are the most effective way to communicate complex ideas. Your ability to craft compelling stories in the form of case studies will mean you close deals faster since your customers will understand the value proposition better.
* A
 **burning desire to learn** 
 and develop deep fintech expertise. Selling API infrastructure is a lot harder (and more rewarding) than selling cashbacks. You will need to know about:
* How financial products work: You’re aware of how financial products are sold to large enterprises.
* Architecture of legacy systems: In order to educate customers on how we can dramatically improve their business, you must first know where existing systems are broken.
* Hands\-on experience in solution\-based sales and a deep understanding of APIs.
* **Relentlessness:** 
 Enterprise sales is all about two words. Following through. Partnerships are rarely closed in one conversation. You will need to be friendly, patient, and relentless.
* **Agility and flexibility:** 
 Setu provides many solutions. You might walk into a conversation planning to sell a particular product, but your conversations might reveal a different and more pressing customer need. At that moment, you must have the presence of mind to alter your sales pitch to address that need and the pitch materials ready to go.
* **Familiarity** 
 with CRM systems, such as Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho and Trello — A craftsman must know their tools.



  





**Why Join Setu:** 




 Lead growth marketing for high\-impact fintech products, work with AI\-powered workflows, and collaborate across product, brand, and business growth teams to make a measurable impact on India’s digital financial ecosystem.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Sales \& Channel Operations Executive – Hullo** 




  





 Location: Juhu (office \+ field visits) · Reports to: Gautam Gupta, Co\-Founder · Type: Full\-time
 



  





**About Hullo** 




 Hullo makes clean\-label fruit, nut and protein bars with no preservatives, made in our own kitchen. We sell through quick\-commerce (Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart), Amazon and 20\+ offline retailers – Nature's Basket, Noble Plus, Urban Platter, cafés, gyms and schools. Because our products have a limited shelf life, freshness and zero returns/expiry at retailers matter as much as sales.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own day\-to\-day sales operations across all our channels. Much of the routine work – requesting retailer reports, computing monthly order suggestions, batch/expiry checks, reminders and dispatch hand\-offs – is already automated. Your job is to run that system, act on what it surfaces, and grow the channels.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




**1\. Offline retailers (\~22 accounts)** 




  





 \* Own relationships with store owners, buyers and category managers; be their single point of contact.
 



 \* Call retailers who haven't shared their monthly sales \& stock report, and chase any missing contacts.
 



 \* Follow up on invoices overdue by 30\+ days (Zoho sends reminders; you make the call).
 



 \* Act on expiry\-risk (RTV) alerts: push in\-store visibility, move stock to faster stores, or pull back before expiry.
 



 \* Log every call in Notion ("DD\-MMM: call – outcome") and keep the per\-retailer P\&L / inventory sheets updated.
 



 \* Onboard new retailers: terms, Zoho customer, Notion entry, first order.
 



 \* Handle retailer questions on pricing, discounts, credit and returns (with Gautam's approval where needed).
 



  





**2\. Quick\-commerce – Blinkit \& Swiggy Instamart** 




 \* Review weekly sales, inventory and ads reports (auto\-downloaded and summarised every Monday) and act on the follow\-ups.
 



 \* Plan purchase orders / replenishment so we avoid stockouts and ageing stock at dark stores.
 



 \* Manage ad campaigns, budgets and discounts; track ROAS.
 



 \* Raise and follow up support tickets and claims (lost stock, payouts, listing issues).
 



  





**3\. Amazon** 




 \* Manage listings, content, pricing and inventory (FBA / seller\-fulfilled).
 



  





**4\. Running the system** 




 \* Work from the daily "Retail – calls for today" email and the Notion Retailers tracker and Master Tasks.
 



 \* Coordinate with Gargi (dispatch \& warehouse) so approved orders ship on time with the right batches.
 



 \* Flag sheet or data problems early; suggest improvements to the automation.
 



  





 \* 2–4 years in FMCG / D2C sales, key\-account management or e\-commerce / quick\-commerce operations.
 



 \* Hands\-on with Blinkit, Instamart or Amazon seller/brand panels (ads \+ inventory) – a strong plus.
 



 \* Comfortable with Excel / Google Sheets; able to read sales, stock and ageing data and spot problems.
 



 \* Organised and follow\-through driven: nothing slips, every call is logged.
 



 \* Confident on the phone with store owners and buyers; good written English and Hindi (Marathi a plus).
 



 \* Comfortable using Notion, Gmail and Zoho Books, and working alongside AI\-driven automation.
 



 \* Willing to visit stores in Mumbai when needed.
 



  





**What success looks like (first 90 days)** 




 \* Every active retailer sends its monthly report, and every overdue call is made and logged.
 



 \* Zero expired stock / returns at retailers; no avoidable stockouts on Blinkit, Instamart or Amazon.
 



 \* Overdue receivables (30\+ days) steadily reduced.
 



 \* Clear weekly view of sales and ad spend by channel.
 



 \* 2–3 new retailers onboarded.
 



  





**Why join** 




 \* Own a multi\-channel sales function end\-to\-end at a fast\-growing food brand.
 



 \* Work directly with the founder; learn quick\-commerce, e\-commerce and modern trade together.
 



 \* A system that does the routine work, so you can focus on retailers and growth.

**About Hurun**  
Hurun is a UK based leading research and rankings organisation focused on wealth, entrepreneurship, business, philanthropy, and high\-growth companies in India.  
Hurun India is best known for its data\-driven rankings and reports that track India’s wealthiest individuals, entrepreneurs, companies, emerging leaders, and high\-value businesses.

**JOB ROLE \- Delegate Acquisition**

Hurun India hosts some of the most considered gatherings in the country. List launches, forums, and closed\-door conversations that bring together founders, investors, and industry leaders. Getting the right people into the room is what makes those rooms worth being in. This role does exactly that. You will be on the phone, on email, and in conversation

with senior business leaders every day, inviting them to participate, profiling their companies before outreach, and following through until they walk in.

What you will do:

→Identify entrepreneurs and industry leaders aligned with each event

→Profile companies carefully before reaching out

→Make outbound calls, send formal invitations, and follow up

→Liaise with delegates from first contact to attendance

→Build and maintain a clean database of industry contacts

→Coordinate with internal teams so delegate lists match event goals

→Keep accurate records of every outreach and confirmation

What we are looking for:

Someone who speaks well. Not in the practiced, scripted way. In the real way. Clear English, a steady voice, a tone that puts the person on the other end of the line at ease within the first few seconds. The kind of person you want to keep talking to. Someone who is unafraid of the phone. This role lives on outbound calls. You will dial people who have never heard of you, introduce yourself with confidence, and hold their attention long enough to make a clean, respectful invitation. You will hear no, often, and stay just as warm on the next call.

Someone who follows through. The difference between a good delegate acquisition executive and a great one is not the first call. It is the second, the third, the polite reminder a week later, the calendar invite that goes out at exactly the right time. The person we are looking for treats follow\-up as the actual job, not an afterthought. Someone who is naturally hospitable. The best people in this role are former hotel front\-desk staff, former cabin crew, former customer\-experience leads, former call\-centre executives. People who know what it feels like to receive a stranger and make them feel looked after. That instinct cannot be trained. We are looking for people who already have it. Someone who is organised. You will be tracking many leaders, many companies, many events at the same time. Names, titles, companies, dates, dietary preferences, travel notes, RSVPs. Nothing should slip. The right person enjoys the small satisfaction of a clean spreadsheet. Someone who is curious about Indian business. You do not need to know who runs which company on day one. But you should be the kind of person who, after one week here, starts to recognise the names. Curiosity goes a long way in this role.

A Bachelor's degree in any discipline. No corporate experience required. If you have worked in a customer\-facing retail role, or anywhere that taught you how to host a stranger and hold a conversation, **if you have experience in inside sales generating leads and making outbound calls,**  you should apply. Training will be provided.

**Position:** Accounts \& Taxation Executive  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 years  
**Qualification:** B. Com / CA Inter  
**Location:** \[Andheri West, Mumbai]

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and responsible **Accounts \& Taxation Executive** to handle day\-to\-day accounting activities and statutory tax compliances. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in accounting, GST and TDS compliances, accounts finalisation, and a good working knowledge of Tally ERP and MS Excel.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting \& Finance**

* Maintain day\-to\-day books of accounts and ensure accurate and timely accounting entries.
* Record and verify purchase, sales, expense, receipt and payment transactions.
* Perform bank, ledger and other account reconciliations.
* Review and maintain proper supporting documentation for accounting transactions.
* Assist in preparation and finalisation of financial statements, including Profit \& Loss Account and Balance Sheet.
* Coordinate with auditors and provide necessary information and supporting documents during audits.
* Assist in preparation of various MIS and financial reports as required.

**GST Compliance**

* Prepare and file monthly/quarterly GST returns, including GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B.
* Perform GST reconciliation and ensure proper matching of input tax credit with relevant records.
* Review GST ledgers and identify discrepancies, if any.
* Assist in handling GST notices, queries and departmental correspondence.

**TDS \& Tax Compliance**

* Calculate and account for TDS on various payments.
* Prepare and file quarterly TDS returns.
* Generate and verify TDS certificates and assist in resolving TDS\-related discrepancies.
* Assist in income\-tax compliance, notices and other direct\-tax related matters, as required.
* Maintain proper records of statutory payments and filings.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Ensure timely completion of assigned statutory and accounting activities.
* Maintain organised records and documentation for accounting and tax purposes.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consultants, auditors and statutory authorities wherever required.
* Keep updated with changes in applicable accounting and tax regulations.
* Support the finance team in other accounting and compliance\-related activities.

**Required Skills**

* Good working knowledge of **Tally ERP / Tally Prime**.
* Hands\-on experience in **GST return filing and GST reconciliation**.
* Hands\-on experience in **TDS calculation and filing of TDS returns**.
* Knowledge of **accounts finalisation**.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Excel**.
* Good understanding of basic accounting principles.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical and reconciliation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet statutory deadlines.

**Qualification \& Experience**

* **B.Com / CA Inter**.
* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience** in accounting and taxation.
* Candidates with experience in handling accounting and statutory compliances independently will be preferred.

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with expected salary and earliest joining date.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Architect agentic, multi\-step AI workflows chaining classification extraction cross\-validation* exception routing with human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints.
* Debug and remediate complex prompt failures (context\-window overflow, instruction drift in long chains, RAG retrieval poisoning, output/format instability).
* Design prompt/model evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy plus consistency, robustness, latency, cost\-per\-call, and hallucination rate.
* Operationalize prompt lifecycle management as production code: versioning, CI/CD prompt tests, A/B experiments, rollback, and audited change history.
* Guide model selection and optimization (prompting vs fine\-tuning vs custom training) balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and data sensitivity.
* Design RAG architectures for financial documents: chunking, embeddings, vector store design, re\-ranking, and context injection.
* Oversee fine\-tuning/training workflows: dataset curation, annotation quality, training configurations, and generalization across document variants.
* Build and maintain evaluation infrastructure: benchmark/golden datasets, regression suites, and automated scoring to catch regressions pre\-production.
* Define confidence calibration and escalation logic so systems estimate uncertainty and route low\-confidence outputs to human reviewers with the right context.
* Partner with governance/model risk and data engineering: produce validator\-ready documentation (explainability/auditability) and ensure robust, refreshed data/annotation/eval pipelines; drive AI\-native development practices to improve velocity.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:**


* 10\+ years in NLP/AI/ML or computational linguistics, including 3\+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.
* Hands\-on LLM internals expertise: tokenization impacts, attention limits, context window management, and temperature/sampling trade\-offs.
* Proven prompt architecture design/debugging: multi\-turn chains, few\-/many\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, self\-consistency, and constitutional AI.
* Strong RAG system design experience: embeddings trade\-offs (e.g., ada/BGE/Cohere), chunking for semi\-structured docs, hybrid retrieval (dense\+sparse), and re\-ranking.
* Fine\-tuning experience: LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO, dataset curation, and evaluating tuned vs prompted performance.
* Python \+ ML engineering proficiency: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex (or equivalents), vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector), and API development.

* Structured output enforcement in production: JSON mode, function calling, constrained decoding, output parsers, and schema validation.
* Build\-vs\-buy/model selection track record: benchmarking foundation models (GPT\-4/Claude/Llama/Mistral) against task requirements.
* Leadership under ambiguity: pragmatic trade\-offs, rapid iteration as practices evolve, and strong communication with compliance, risk, and business stakeholders.

* Experience with model distillation to produce smaller, faster models for cost\-effective deployment.
